text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Good morning, world! And what a pristine morning it is!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The loving warmth of sunlight dappled through the leaves, pretty little birds singing their darling songs…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It is as if the world is celebrating my awakening!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This must all be the work of that wonderful Umamusume who appeared in my dreams…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thank you, me! For this beautiful morning!

text_block_list.name: Phantom Opera O
text_block_list.text: There is no need for thanks, me. I would gladly visit you in dreamland, time and time again!
